book.name: Wangarini
book.title: Wangarini kuku Nuw Wangi siyaam yandakuri, Isusoo kuk kamanchintspa

content: Minootssha kamanchintspa; yuwaa Isus, Utaáshuch kurak nuwaa waani tsiyantachinllinpa átu, tputsee yararangu anootsi
Isus Galileyash taarangu, anamunsha yusur Irusarinap shambatshisheem napatama táyaru, naateeru, anush kusarangiya.

Anush opeejanung washitungashi, kung chumashish taarangu, Isus anush naparangiya. Chumashish Utaáshuchiri kuk Betsatcha sura. Wantsshuri kung kapootpoottar ashtariya. Annungiri zameetpata kariyshish taarangiya.
Wanguy anush zapan tamutamur ashtarana. Wach mchusawtam, chpanawtam, wanuts muxareewtam, wanguy anush zapan tamuranganaya. Kung nuwaa yarpanda atusin, anush kutaranganaya.

Ashiruch, Isus anush kuseeru, tputsee kas yutaku an chamayangarangiya. An tputs 38 masach kas yutarangiya. Mangu tamoo ashirangiya. Itaru, Isus pakeeru, waanitari yasarangiya yuwaa sirútari kas yutarangu anootsi. Isussha wanguyaatssha: ¿Yarpi átish shiya? átu,

wanguysha: Aa, zandaktana, tárangu. Itaru, ¿tamaycheezi? ¿Chakaja nuwaa istachinda? ¿Chakaja mikeeru nuwaa kungush wayachinda? Kung kapootkachu nuwsha apinll pshiyratat ashkuri, tputsima nllitarit ichtaru chipuykatssin, uru nuwsha xapookina; pinasakina, tárangiya.
Isussha: Chiyzangi shiya. Nllamareetsish yáyarush, naangi, tárangiya.
Támpinand wanguysha chiyzarangiya. Wayanllamaree yáyaru, naanata ashirangiya. An zari sápatush, kanusisshu, Isus ashirangiya.

Ashirucha, wanguy wayanllamaree chipapata sheeranllu, iysha kurakarini anoo pakeersin, tsiyantarangana. Wanguyaatssha nambku, ¿Mayaamsha nllamareetsish chipaksha? ¿Watam nat in zari kanusischa? tárangiya kuraka.
Wanguysha: Zuraktishcha, ichee. Itaru, tputs nuwaa yareeru, Nllamareetsish yáyarush, naangi, táranguwa; tárangiya.
Kuraksha: ¿Chak shiyaa kamachtaranga? ¿Chaka sura? táyarusin,

wanguyasha: ¿Chakamasaja? yasareezi nuwa, tárangiya, watam Isus mikeeru tsíparanguwa. Tputs anush zapan shaneerana ashiriya, Isussha kamuzaa yareeru, mikeeru naata sheeru, tsípata ashirangiya. Ashirucha, wanguy Isusoo nda yasarangiya.

Anamunsha Isus wanguyaa nachungarangiya. Apanllush pang' pakeeru, wanguyaatssha: Mazinangcha; na shiyaa yareenlluri, yusur Apanllee kuk kpitinllpa; wanasiri taangcha. Papcha, Apanll waneeyanllpa; yusur misisanashapa kas yutatsha, tárangiya Isusu.
Sheeru, Isusoo natstayaru, kurakapsha kamankatu naatarangiya. Kurakush kuseeru, Isustanda nuwaa yararanganda, tárangiya.
Anumun iy kurakarini Isusoo natsarangana, yuwash zari kanussish tputsee yararangu anumanda.

Ashirucha, Isusoo parangusin, ¿Mayaamsha shiy ashiksha? tárangusin, Isussha: Nuw Apari tamapari ashiruri tputsee istamaam kanuskeezi. Nuw anpaniri taakina; kanusisshutaata zari yarkina, tárangiya Isusu.
Táyaru, kuraksha ksumish tsiyantarangana; Izuuru pachayani, watam kanusisshu nda kanuskuwa; mishat Apanlleerutana ashki átu waanaatsi Apanlleem ínakuwa; waanpatatin mang, tárangana.

Isussha waatssin itsinsaru yámarangiya; Nuwaa kuki mazinangtsa; niri chinangtsa. Nitaati nuwaanimuntaja wizpuriri taaki, nda; Apapamun taakina. Nuw izuuru Apapaa mangoonaktana. Mangoonkuri, Apap tamapari ashiktana. Apapaa pakuri, anuritam tuminkina; nllitari chinamaam pinasaktana.

Apap nuwaa chinaku, waanaatsi chínash nuwaa kamankiya. Anuri tuminkina nuwa. Ashirucha, tuminkuri, siysa Apapaa wizpuririni parangis; tputsee yararangtana. Parangus, punirustarangsa. Itaru, xamachee, wand pishtakiya; aranginashapa pangatssa. Kizpur punirustatssa.
Apap taarashipancha. Tsipareetstaa ituyamakiya. Ashiritamana nuwa. Nuwaana zandkuri, tputsee ituyamachima; nuw taarashipantamana. Tatsamkiniya.

Mishat, Apap tputsee mang' natstampancha. Apap natstampan taakiya. Itaru, uw waana tputsee natstakitaa nda waneekiya. Nuwaa, Shiysha, ipari, shaana tputsee mang' natstayarush waneengcha; nuwaa, tárangiya.

Tputs ipareetsi chinapana átu nuwaa kamachtarangiya. Apapaa chinakana ashiritam nuwaa chinamaam waritakiya. Ashiriya, tputs nuwaa nda kuki payuku, Apapaatstam kuk nda payukiya, watam Apap nuwaa zanganiranguwa. Tputs nda nuwaa chinaku, Apapaatstam nda chinakiya. Tatsamooriniya iya.

Kaapa mazinangandama; tputs nuwaa kuki mangoonkinaariya ashiru, Apapaatstam mangoonchitamtaya, watam nuwaa zanganiranguwa. Mangoonkachu, nuwamun Apanlleem urutamari taachiya, yutaritshishimand wanicheezi, ndambaree. Anumun waneeship ndusha naachiya; taarashish urutamash yachiya izuurumamaritaya.

Mazinangandama; itsinsaru kamankina. Apanll taarashipancha. Ashiritamti, nuw taarashipantamana. Ashirucha, naturit ini tputs tsipar tamapari ashiru waneeshish taaktaa, itaru nuwaa kuki mangoonku, Apanllishshapa urutamari taachiya. Yutaritaa taarangu, itaru nuwaa mangoonku, Apanlleemsha taachiya.

Tputseem kinarangitaati, ashiritaati, na nuwaana yasachima tputseetsi mangu. Wanimaam waritakinaari, wanichima; istamaam waritakinaariya, taarashish urutamash panachina. Apanll waana tputsee ichinguru yasachiya.

Yuwash zari waritakchu anush nuwsha tputsee tsiparee kuruzkachuri, nuwaatssha kuki mazinaku, támchinllinaya. Anoo wasina kamaniranguri, punirustarintspa. Tputs wanasir taaranginaari, matspasheemsha ínakchuri, uwsha urutamari taachiya. Itaru, tputs yutarit taaranginaari, ituyamakchitaati, waneeshish wayachima urutamari kiyung kachiymaama.

Nuwaanamuntari wizpuriri taakeezi. Apapamun wizpuri taakina. Tputsee mang' natstayaruri, itsinsasha natstakina. Apap nuwaa kamachtaku, anuritam itsinsaru payukina; itsinsaru tputsee natstakina. Apapaatsimari kuk payupi turi, anuritam chinaktana.
Nuwaantaja siyaa kamanki, nda. Nllitarit nuwaa kamankitamta. Nuwaanitaritanaari minamti kamankuri, ashiri siysa nuwaa: Ngichikpasha, támaam waritachparee.
Itaru, nllitari nuwaa kamankiya; Apapcha nuwaa wasina kamanirangu; uw kuk itsinsampancha; nuwaa itsinsaru kamankiya.
Mishat, Wangarini nuwaa kamanirangtamta. Siy uwaa masharangus, uwsha siyaa itsinsaru kamanirangiya; Nuwamun kushi Apanll Ipusamarini kuschiya, tárangiya nuwaatsi.

Wangarin, tárangitaa, nuw Wangarinimuni kuk nda kizpur taaki, watam uw tputsimunawa. Itaru, Apapamuncha kuk kizpur taaki. Mangeetsis p'tsimaam Wangarineetsi kuk kamankina. Siyaa mangoonpana turi, mangeetsis p'tseekina. Kamungpana aturi, siyaa atashina.
Wangarini siyaa tayaspatarangu, kis mazinarangsa. Nambarin tamaparee ashiru mangeetsis 'sineerangiya. Wanasiri tayaspatarangu, kis mazinamana mazinarangsa natumasamta.

Wangarini nuwaa kamanirangtaa, itaru yuwamun tputsee yarki anumun nuwaa mangoonamaam waritariya. Apap nuwaa zanganirangiya átana. Anuri mangoonangtsa. Apap nuwaa kamachtarangiya kizpur ashimaama. Apanll tamatarpari sheeranlluri, wanip siysa parangsa. Anumun nuwaa mangoonamaam waritariya.

Sirútari Apaptam kuk nuwaa kamanirangiya. Watacha nuwaa zanganirangu anu. Nuwaa zanganirangtaa, itaru siysa nuwaa ngataksa. Ashirucha, nuwaa ngatkus, ¿tamaree siy Apapaa mazinachis? ¿tamaree siy Apapaa yasachis? ¿tamaree Apapaa kuk mangoonchis? Pinasaksa. Apapaa kuk nda mangoonaksa siya.

Siy Apanllee yandamarini kapung natstaksa. Apanll nuwaa kis napanda átus, Apanllee kuk kapung natstaksa. Kapung natstakinaari taarashish urutamash yachima, mangishis ngutis átus, zapan natstaksa. Antaati yuwamun kapung natstakis anumun Apanll siyaa kis napach, nda. Yuwamun nuwaa mangoonkis anumun kis napchiya, watam Apanll kuk nuwaa kamankuwa. Apanll yandamarin nuwaa kamankitaa, ashiritaa siy nuwaa ngataksa. Taarashee urutamashee kanachatssa siyaya.
Nuw siyaa yasaktana; siy nda Apanllee chinaksa. Ashiritam siy nuwaa nduntam chinaksa. ¿Nitaati tputs nuwaa kis napanda turi kusarangeezi? nda. Apapaa kamachtamarini tuminpi turi kusarangina.

Apanll nuwaa zanganirangu, nuw nish tsapurunasush kusarangina. Ashiritaa siysa nuwaa mangoonamaam ngataksa. Itaru, nllitaritanaari tputs msangeeru kuseeru, nduntaa Apanll zanganku, siysa anootssha kis napaksa; waa kuk ngatcheezis, ndambaree. Watam Apanlleetsimari nda chinaksawa. Apanll nuwaa kischa chinapanda nda átssawa. Apanllee mapiyksa. Siy tputseetsimari chinaksa. Ashirucha, anumun nuwaa mangoonamaam pinasaksa.

Siy nduntaa nuwaa mangoonkus, ashiritaa nuw siyaa nda tístachina. Apaa, an tputs yutaritssincha; shiysha waneengcha; tácheezi, ndambari. Itaru, siyaa Móysisarinimand yandamarini yutaritshishush wayachiya; anumand siyaa waneeshish wayachiya. Móysisarinimuna kuk kamungchima, atitaateesa, itaru nda mangoonaksawa.
Móysisarineetsini kuk mangoonkinaareesa ashiru, nuwaatstam mangoonatssa, watam Móysisarini wasina nuwaa kamaniranguwa. Nuwaa kamanirangtaa, itaru siysa nuwaa ngataksa.

Siy Móysisarin yandamarini mangooncheezis, ashiriya nuwaatsinashtaja mangoonchis siya. Kapunguri pinasaksa, Isusu, tárangiya Utaáshucheetsi kurakarini. Ashiri yuwaa Isus waanaatsi kamanirangu anoo kamaneena.

footnotes.text: -4 Versícul 4 kaap wanindaja. Ashpatam kirak anoo taar, itaru Wangarini anoo nda kaap yandarangiya. Yandamarini ateeja: “Kung kapootpoottaru anush minamari tputs ichtaru chipuykachu, yarta ashtariya. Mang, Apanll wasundurur zapish kusta, yusur zapish mang kusta ashku, wantsush pshtuyaru, mang kungoo iturpipitara ashirangiya.”
